basePath = self.view.params.Tagpathfolder
	
	tags = system.tag.browse(basePath).getResults()
	
	paths = []
	names = []
	
	for t in tags:
		tagPath = basePath + "/" + t['name']
		paths.append(tagPath)
		
		# format parameter name
		formattedName = t['name'].replace("_", " ").title()
		names.append(formattedName)
	
	# read tag values
	values = system.tag.readBlocking(paths)
	
	data = []
	
	for i, v in enumerate(values):
	
		tagPath = paths[i]
	
		# read engineering unit
		uom = system.tag.readBlocking([tagPath + ".EngUnit"])[0].value
	
		val = v.value
		if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
			val = round(val, 2)
	
		data.append([
			names[i],
			str(val),
			str(uom),
			str(v.quality)
		])
	
	dataset = system.dataset.toDataSet(
		["Parameter", "Actual Value", "UOM", "Quality"],
		data
	)
	
	return dataset
